candidate.de: The grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity.
candidate.en: The grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity.

candidate.de: Kumpanija — Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
candidate.en: Kumpanija — Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.

candidate.de: A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island to the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village.
candidate.en: The major religious event of the year in Čara, centred on the church of Gospa od Carskog Polja in the field below the village. A traditional procession draws villagers and visitors from across the island.
candidate.fr: L'événement religieux majeur de l'année à Čara, centré sur l'église de Gospa od Carskog Polja dans le champ en dessous du village. Une procession traditionnelle rassemble les villageois et les visiteurs de l'île.
candidate.hr: Glavno vjersko događanje godine u Čari, oko crkve Gospa od Carskog Polja u polju ispod sela. Tradicionalni procesije privlače seljane i posjetitelje s cijele otočke.
candidate.it: L'evento religioso più importante dell'anno a Čara, centrato sulla chiesa di Gospa od Carskog Polja nel campo sotto il villaggio. Una processione tradizionale raccoglie i villaggi e i visitatori dell'isola.
candidate.sl: Glavno versko dogajanje leta v Čari, okoli cerkve Gospa od Carskog Polja v polju pod vasjo. Tradicionalna procesija privablja vaščane in obiskovalce celotne otok.

candidate.de: Eines der ältesten Dorf-Folklore-Traditionen auf Korčula. Die Kumpanija-Schwerttanz-Gruppe ist eine der fünf Dorfgruppen, die den Kumpanija-Schwerttanz auf Korčula Island erhalten haben.
candidate.en: One of the oldest village folklore traditions on Korčula. The Kumpanija sword dance group is one of the five village groups that have preserved the Kumpanija sword dance on Korčula Island.
candidate.fr: L'une des plus anciennes traditions folkloriques du village de Korčula. Le groupe de danse de l'épée Kumpanija est l'une des cinq groupes de village qui ont préservé le Kumpanija dans le village de Korčula.
candidate.hr: Jedno od najstarijih seljačkih folklornih tradicija na Korčuli. Kumpanija klapa je jedna od pet klapa koje su očuvale Kumpaniju u selu Korčuli.
candidate.it: Una delle più antiche tradizioni folkloriche del villaggio di Korčula. Il gruppo di danza Kumpanija è uno dei cinque gruppi di villaggio che hanno conservato il Kumpanija a Korčula Island.
candidate.sl: Ena izmed najstarejših seljskih folklornih tradicij na Korčuli. Klapa Kumpanija je ena izmed pet klap, ki so ohranile Kumpanijo v Korčuli.
